C1376.title: BitFloor Exchange Loses 24,000 BTC Due to Unencrypted Wallet Key Backup
C1376.summary: In September 2012, hackers attacked the BitFloor exchange and stole 24,000 bitcoins. The root cause was an unencrypted backup of wallet keys that let the attackers easily obtain the keys and steal the massive crypto assets; BitFloor's creator Roman Shtylman paused operations and ultimately shut the exchange down.
